Middle-of-night waking at 8 is pretty common when stress, school things, or a shift in her routine has disrupted her sleep cycle - the brain stirs at the end of a natural sleep stage and she's not quite resettling herself. A consistent, calm wind-down starting 30-45 minutes before bed (dim lights, no screens, same order every night) is the first thing to try; it usually tightens the cycle back up within a week or two.
